title: Linking water–sediment respiration to micropollutant biodegradation across aquatic environments
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00099A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Arild Gustafsson, Joeselle M. Serrana, Run Tian, Michael S. McLachlan, Malte Posselt
Water–sediment respiration was positively correlated with the attenuation rates of 23 of the 34 organic micropollutants measured across 10 river sites. Normalizing attenuation by respiration decreased average standard deviation across the dataset.
